title: DreamMusicForge Character Performance Package
description: Solves two problems raised for productions where characters sing themselves rather than a narrator: (1) character consistency across independently generated shots, via a character-reference image generated once per character and reused as conditioning for every shot that character appears in (the historical continuity problem this pipeline never built a solution for); (2) per-character vocal performance replacing a single narrator voice, with lip-sync required wherever a character sings on camera. no_narrator is a literal hard gate, not a design note -- it must be true or the document fails validation.

no_narrator.description: Must be true. This document exists specifically to replace narration with characters performing themselves.

character_reference_provider.description: Not locked to an enum, consistent with the rest of the provider layer. As of this writing the motivating candidate is Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash Image model ("Nano Banana"), chosen for character-consistency across independently generated images.

character_references.description: One entry per character who appears on camera. Every character_name must match a name in the paired Universal Production Blueprint's narrative_supplement.character_biographies (checked by validate_against_blueprint).

source_fields_used.description: Which character_biographies fields this reference prompt was actually derived from.

vocal_performers.description: Every character_name must also have a character_references entry (you can't lip-sync a character whose visual identity was never established). Every sings_during_shot_ids entry must exist in the paired Cinematic Architecture's shots (checked by validate_against_cinematic_architecture).

lip_sync_required.description: Must be true for every performer -- if a character sings on camera, lip sync is not optional.

contains.const: This kernel does not claim to guarantee any specific viewer belief, emotion, or decision.
